top_signals.title: Nvidia customers reportedly warned about AI-related price hikes
top_signals.summary: The chipmaker has told some of its largest customers that the prices of servers containing its AI chips could move more than 15% higher, Bloomberg News reported.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Patria to join with Ukraine’s General Cherry to make drones in Finland
top_signals.summary: Finnish defense company Patria is teaming up with Ukrainian drone maker General Cherry to jointly develop drones and start production in Finland.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Two US tanker aircraft leave Bulgaria a month after deployment upset Iran
top_signals.summary: Two U.S. tanker aircraft have left Bulgaria’s Bezmer air base, Bulgaria’s defense minister said, after their deployment in the Balkan country angered Iran.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Fasset reaches unicorn status after $68 million raise led by SBI Group
top_signals.summary: Fasset raised $68 million in Series C funding at a $1 billion valuation, expanding its cross-border stablecoin infrastructure.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
